description: This PHP file defines a class for handling the third step of an import process within SuiteCRM, a CRM extension derived from SugarCRM. It manages the user interface for mapping CSV file columns to module fields, handles file parsing, and provides UI interactions for import configuration.

classes.name: ImportViewStep3
classes.description: A class handling the rendering and logic for step 3 of the import wizard, including file parsing, field mapping, and UI setup.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the import step 3 UI, processes the import file, and prepares data for mapping and user interaction.

methods.name: getMappingClassName
methods.description: Determines and loads the appropriate mapping class based on import source.

methods.name: getRequestDelimiter
methods.description: Returns the delimiter used in the import file, based on user input or default.

methods.name: getImportColumns
methods.description: Extracts the column mappings from the request parameters.

methods.name: _getCSS
methods.description: Provides custom CSS styles for the import UI.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript for client-side validation and UI interactions during import.
